(1) the basic and applied analyses of human behavior are not well integrated, (2) the basic analysis of behavior has not produced the kinds of technologies that have been developed in other sciences, (3) the disconnection between basic and applied behavior analysis is a problem, (4) the problem is solvable, and (5) a solution requires the development of collaborative research programs between basic and applied investigators.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of behavioral technology, which is defined as the application of behavioral analysis to the solution of problems that affect the quality of life of individuals.
the analysis and control of behavior in natural settings and with the development of a technology for doing so.
the analysis and solution of human problems, and the basic research that we conduct is designed to contribute to the development of effective behavioral technologies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the basic research needed to stimulate the development of behavioral technology is the same as the basic research needed for the continued development of behavior analysis as a science.
the basic and applied research in the field of behavior analysis should be more closely integrated.
the basic research needed for the development of behavioral technology is the same as that needed for the development and refinement of basic behavioral science.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the basic research we have conducted on response allocation, resistance, and countercontrol is relevant to the development of effective behavioral technology.

the development of behavioral technology will be greatly aided by a better understanding of the basic behavioral processes involved in the behavior of concern, and that the best way to achieve this understanding is through the deliberate interaction of basic and applied behavioral researchers.
basic research on behavior is needed to stimulate the development of behavioral technology, and behavioral technology is needed to stimulate basic research on behavior.
The main takeaway from our work is that
basic and applied behavior analysts need to work together to solve the problems that confront us.
the basic and applied research programs of behavior analysts are not in conflict, but rather they are complementary.
we need to do more basic research to develop behavioral technologies.
